hero.title: GeoAnalyzer
hero.subtitle: Intelligent urban environment analysis system for informed decision-making

mission.text_1: This is an intelligent answer to real estate market opacity. We prove that quality of life and comfort are not subjective feelings, but concrete metrics that can be measured. Our platform transforms millions of raw urban data points into precise analytical ratings.
mission.text_2: We are creating a new standard for urban analytics. Our goal is to provide every user, from tenants to strategic investors, with a tool for a deep understanding of infrastructure, safety, and the potential of any neighborhood.

features.title: Social Infrastructure
features.text: Deep analysis of the educational and medical network. We evaluate not only the number of schools and hospitals but also their real accessibility and density per capita.

features.title: Transport & Logistics
features.text: Comprehensive mobility assessment: from proximity to metro and tram lines to the length of bike lanes and parking zone availability.

features.title: Safety & Security
features.text: Monitoring of crime rates, street lighting quality, and CCTV density to ensure your peace of mind.

features.title: Ecology & Environment
features.text: Objective data on air quality, noise pollution levels, percentage of green spaces, and availability of recreation zones within walking distance.

features.title: Commercial Potential
features.text: Market saturation analysis: from grocery chains and shopping malls to bank branches and dining establishments.

features.title: Economic Indicators
features.text: Analytics of price per square meter, rental price dynamics, and average salary in the district for precise ROI calculation.

process.title: Location Selection
process.text: Use the interactive map to instantly select a city or outline a specific search zone within Poland.

process.title: Smart Scoring
process.text: The algorithm automatically analyzes the location using 50+ Big Data parameters and forms detailed environmental quality ratings.

process.title: Comparative Analysis
process.text: Compare metrics of several districts side-by-side to reveal hidden advantages and critical drawbacks of each location.

process.title: Final Assessment & Report
process.text: Receive a comprehensive analysis of costs, infrastructure, and risks in a convenient format for making a weighted decision.

data_sources.title: Information Sources:
items: Partner networks of real estate aggregators

data_sources.title: Methodology & Data Processing:
items: Multi-level verification and cleaning of raw data
Automatic aggregation of indicators using proprietary algorithms
Daily updates of dynamic indicators (prices, ecology)
Geospatial mapping of infrastructure objects to district boundaries
Intelligent anomaly detection and result validation by analysts

audience.title: Private Individuals
audience.text: For those seeking the perfect balance of price and quality of life. Find a quiet neighborhood with a school or a vibrant center for youth.

audience.title: Private Investors
audience.text: Minimize risks by relying on hard facts, not intuition. Assess the potential for neighborhood capitalization growth.

audience.title: Realtors & Agencies
audience.text: Increase expertise in the eyes of clients. Use our professional White Label reports.

audience.title: Developers
